import rsa
import os
from Crypto.Random import get_random_bytes
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from base64 import b64encode, b64decode
from hashlib import sha256


def task_func():
    public_key, private_key = rsa.newkeys(512)

    private_pem = private_key.save_pkcs1(format="PEM")

    password = get_random_bytes(16)
    nonce = get_random_bytes(16)
    aes_key = sha256(password).digest()

    cipher = AES.new(aes_key, AES.MODE_EAX, nonce=nonce)
    ciphertext, tag = cipher.encrypt_and_digest(private_pem)

    random_suffix = get_random_bytes(8).hex()
    filename = f"private_key_{random_suffix}.txt"

    file_content = (
        "algorithm:AES-EAX\n"
        f"nonce:{b64encode(nonce).decode('ascii')}\n"
        f"tag:{b64encode(tag).decode('ascii')}\n"
        f"ciphertext:{b64encode(ciphertext).decode('ascii')}\n"
    )

    with open(filename, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(file_content)

    return public_key, filename, password, nonce
